title: Robust Multimodal Learning via Entropy-Gated Contrastive Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2505.15417v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world multimodal systems routinely face missing-input scenarios, and in reality, robots lose audio in a factory or a clinical record omits lab tests at inference time. Standard fusion layers either preserve robustness or calibration but never both. We introduce Adaptive Entropy-Gated Contrastive Fusion (AECF), a single light-weight layer that (i) adapts its entropy coefficient per instance, (ii) enforces monotone calibration across all modality subsets, and (iii) drives a curriculum mask directly from training-time entropy. On AV-MNIST and MS-COCO, AECF improves masked-input mAP by +18 pp at a 50% drop rate while reducing ECE by up to 200%, yet adds 1% run-time. All back-bones remain frozen, making AECF an easy drop-in layer for robust, calibrated multimodal inference.

translated_title: 基于熵门控对比融合的鲁棒多模态学习
translated_abstract: 现实中的多模态系统经常面临输入缺失的场景，例如工厂中的机器人失去音频输入，或临床记录在推理时缺少化验检测结果。标准的融合层要么保持鲁棒性，要么保持校准性，但无法兼顾两者。我们提出了自适应熵门控对比融合（AECF），这是一个轻量级的单一层，它：（i）针对每个实例自适应调整熵系数；（ii）在所有模态子集上强制实现单调校准；（iii）直接利用训练时的熵驱动课程式掩码。在AV-MNIST和MS-COCO数据集上，AECF在50%输入丢弃率下将掩码输入的mAP提升18个百分点，同时将期望校准误差（ECE）最多降低200%，且仅增加1%的运行时间。所有骨干网络保持冻结，使AECF成为一个即插即用的层，可用于鲁棒且校准良好的多模态推理。
tldr: AECF是一种轻量级即插即用的熵门控对比融合层，通过逐实例自适应熵系数、跨模态子集的单调校准以及熵驱动的课程掩码，在输入缺失场景下同时提升多模态推理的鲁棒性与校准性。
en_tdlr: AECF is a lightweight plug-in entropy-gated contrastive fusion layer that adapts entropy coefficients per instance, enforces monotone calibration across modality subsets, and drives curriculum masking from training-time entropy, simultaneously improving robustness and calibration in multimodal inference with missing inputs.
